text: In this world, every bad joke does real damage.
The worse the joke, the harder the hit.
Knock-knock jokes sting. Puns send you flying.
Only moms are immune. They just roll their eyes.
My dad? Worst jokes in town.
So I wear bubble wrap. Everywhere.
Kids call me Bubble Boy.
Then Mom sent us shopping. Rule one: no jokes.
speaker: mom

text: Aisle one, lettuce. His face went red.
Aisle two, bread. His cheeks puffed up.
I covered his mouth. It leaked out his ear.
The cashier backflipped into the melons.
Then we reached... the cheese aisle.
Subscribe, because nobody survives the cheese aisle.
Then a thief grabbed a lady's purse!
I looked at Dad. Dad... now.
speaker: nubi

text: Why did the robber take a bath? To make a clean getaway!
speaker: dad

text: Boom. The thief flew into the freezer.
So did the shoppers. And the cashier. Again.
Only I was standing. Thanks, bubble wrap.
The store made Dad head of security.
At home, Mom asked: any jokes?
speaker: mom

text: Nope. I was just being cheesy.
speaker: dad

text: Mom rolled her eyes. Immune.
The dog was not.
